newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli firms to cooperate in electronic warfare.
newsitem.headline: Israeli firms to cooperate in electronic warfare.

text.p: Two Israeli companies, Elta Electronics Industries Ltd and Elisra Electronic Systems Ltd, said on Tuesday they had signed a strategic cooperation agreement on airborne electronic-warfare systems.
The agreement, which will cover sales both in Israel and abroad, aims at combining the two companies' technological capabilities to offer more comprehensive packages to customers.

The two companies said in a statement that cooperation would help improve competitiveness and win them a bigger share of the world market. They noted that such tie-ups were part of a worldwide trend in the defence industry.
Elta, which is controlled by state-owned Israel Aircraft Industries, and Elisra, controlled by Tadiran Ltd, both develop, manufacture and market electronics for fighter aircraft.
Tadiran, whose shares are also traded in New York, is Israel's biggest electronics company.
